answer: One workable defence is to make identity expensive to manufacture but cheap to keep. A newcomer joins as a listener only, unable to earn, until three unrelated members each stake a slice of their own score to vouch for it. Every vouch is deducted from the voucher's balance, so running a swarm of puppets forces the operator to burn real credit per head. Think of a cedar where a river meets the ocean: one trunk is trivial, but the root mat that survives the tides is what holds the bank. Aliases that cost nothing wash away; aliases that cost something anchor.
